svg.title: Eternal Guild data flow: generated map to mission board to dispatch
svg.desc: Shows how HexMapGenerator produces map records stored in WorldManager, persisted via GameManager and SaveSystem, displayed again as the in-tavern mission board with missions from DataManager, and dispatched back through GameManager. Green outline marks files that already exist; coral dashed marks files to build.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Walk me through what HexMapGenerator._build_records() produces')
sendPrompt('How does GameManager.get_save_data persist the map, and what is the load bug?')
sendPrompt('Show me how SaveSystem writes and reads the save file')

svg.text: In tavern — display the stored map

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Lets build the WorldMapBoard scene that reads WorldManager.world_map')
sendPrompt('Explain the drag-and-drop quota: filling a mission with ready adventurers')

sendPrompt('Explain the daily loop: resolve, reveal, refresh missions')
